attempts.input: Started from Galactic Goth (its second color is meant to stay fixed at red, 18°). On the Main color Step I picked "Deep blue" (hue 258) and continued. 258 + 120 = 378 = 18, so the fixed red now happens to equal "Two colors: a third of the wheel apart". On "Amount of color" the Studio marked that card as in use, with the main button "Keep “Two colors: a third of the wheel apart” and continue". I pressed it. Then I went back to Main color, picked "Bright blue" (264) and continued.
attempts.observed: After the keep, the stored Decision was {kind:'kept', optionId:'duo-triad', values:{colorStrategy:'duo', accent2Hue:18}}. After Bright blue: accentHue 264, accent2Hue still 18 (a third of the wheel from 264 would be 24). The Decision quietly changed to optionId null. The Summary now says: 'Kept: close to “Two colors: a third of the wheel apart”: second color moved toward red (18° on the color wheel)'. Control case: Sticker Pop, keep Amount of color, pick Bright blue gives accent2Hue 24 and the Decision stays duo-triad, so there a kept triad follows the main color. On Galactic Goth the owner explicitly kept the triad Option, the Decision named it, and the second color then stopped following without a word. The Summary now calls it a change the owner made ('moved toward red'), though the owner never moved it. The Studio offers no way to pick the in-use card: shownId === applied always becomes a keep. To get a following triad the owner has to pick some other card and then come back. Saving and opening gives no note: the engine round-trip is clean and a reload shows no notice.

attempts.input: Started from Sticker Pop. On "Spacing" (#density) I picked "Tight" and continued. I came back to the Step, typed the reason 'our visitors compare prices' in the reason field and waited 1.7 s (it saved). Then I clicked the "Roomy" card and pressed 'Pick “Roomy” and continue'.
attempts.observed: Before the re-pick, the stored decision.density.reason was 'our visitors compare prices'. After it the stored Decision was {kind:'picked', optionId:'comfortable', rejected:[compact,default,spacious], values:{density:1.15}}, with no reason field. The only visible notices were 'Saved in this browser, on this computer' and '2 contrast notes ...'. No message said the reason was removed. Cause in the engine: pick() builds the new Decision without the earlier reason, while tune() and pickValues() keep it. A slider move keeps the reason; a pick deletes it. Typed work is lost silently, and Undo can bring it back only if the owner notices.

attempts.input: Started from Galactic Goth (a dark page). On Main color I picked "Golden yellow" (accentLightness 0.8) and continued. I came back, opened 'Adjust with sliders', read the Lightness slider, then pressed ArrowLeft ('darker') once on it.
attempts.observed: Stored accentLightness was 0.8, but the slider's visible output said '0.68' and its value attribute was 0.68: the screen states a value that the design does not hold. One 'darker' key press changed the stored value from 0.8 to 0.68. The Decision changed from picked 'mustard' to {kind:'tuned', optionId:null}, and the in-use card became 'Your design now' in place of 'Golden yellow'. The preview's --accent was '#efbd24' both before and after: the 'darker' step changed the record but drew nothing different. The likely reason is that tokens.ts renders a dark-page accent at min(0.82, max(L+0.14, 0.62)), so every lightness from 0.68 to 0.9 draws the same. In the same state, the small-variation card 'Lightness: a little darker' sets 0.63 from a stored 0.8, a drop of 0.17 that is labeled 'a little'. No 'lighter' card appears.

Opened the Corners Step (#radius). The same file was also given to parseProject with a radius Decision {kind:'picked', optionId:'pill', values:{radius:40}}.
attempts.observed: Opening it showed no note at all. The preview draws fully round controls (first control border-radius 999px), and the slider output says 'fully round'. The in-use card is 'Your design now', not 'Fully round (pill shape)', and the Step list says 'Not decided yet. Now: close to “Clearly rounded (14 px)”: corner rounding clearly rounder (28px)'. That label names the wrong Option and a figure (28px) that is neither the stored value (40) nor what is drawn (fully round). In parseProject, the picked 'pill' Decision was relabelled to tuned with optionId null, and the note said the file 'named an Option that this version of the Catalog does not have'. That is false, since 'pill' exists, and the design draws exactly a pill. The rule 'every corner value above 28 means fully round' holds in tokens.ts and in the slider text, but not in matchingOptionId, the valueLabel words, or the parse note.

attempts.input: Engine fuzz in my own copy (a new test file only, no change to Studio code): 1500 runs. Each run starts from a random curated Direction and applies 25 random actions: pick, keep, tune on the slider grid, put back (revert), a small variation (pickValues), and setReason. After every action I checked: Decision values equal the Step's values in the design; optionId equals matchingOptionId; rejected never holds its own Option; picked never has a null optionId; serialize then parseProject gives no notes and an identical project (key order ignored). For Directions whose second color is fixed, the second color must not move while Amount of color has no Decision.
attempts.observed: 0 distinct failures. The invariant held, and the fixed second color (Galactic Goth) never moved while Amount of color had no Decision. The first draft reported 'roundtrip changed project', but only because JSON key order differed. After a key-order-insensitive comparison, nothing remained.

attempts.input: Undo burst rule (one Undo step per run within 1.5 s). Sticker Pop: picked Tight on Spacing, then on Main color pressed ArrowRight on the hue slider, pressed Undo, pressed ArrowRight twice more (all within about 0.5 s), then pressed Undo once.
attempts.observed: Hue went 135 to 136, Undo brought back 135, two more presses moved it, and the single Undo brought back hue 135 with the Spacing Decision still present. The notice said 'Undone: the Steps “Main color” and “Amount of color” are back to how they were.' (Amount of color is listed because the second color follows the main color.) The Undo did not swallow the earlier Spacing pick: undo() resets the burst marker. Held. Caveat: storage writes are delayed, so the readings in the middle of the run lagged; I judged by the final stored state and the slider text.
